# Pinned firmware source-contract fixtures

Unchanged source/license data from Firmingo commit `d42613faa1abd1f4bcbbb361e9f0855d28890824`.
Paths, roles, bytes and SHA-256 are pinned in the Nano firmware-contract mapping.
These headers/native proof files are never built or executed by these tests and
do not replace the compiler recipe. Firmingo GPL-3.0 attribution and full license
are retained in `contract/LICENSE`; normal tests need no sibling checkout.
